description: Expected output schema when the triage agent creates or updates a Jira ticket

required_fields.summary: Short title, max 80 chars, imperative tone e.g. 'Fix login crash on iOS after deploy'
required_fields.description: Structured markdown with: ## What, ## Steps to Reproduce (bugs), ## Expected, ## Context
required_fields.priority: One of: Critical | High | Medium | Low

optional_fields.assignee: Jira account ID — only set if confidently known
optional_fields.epic_link: Jira epic key if message clearly belongs to a known epic
optional_fields.story_points: Only set for Stories/Tasks, not Bugs

priority_guide.Critical: All users affected, production down, data loss, security issue
priority_guide.High: Significant feature broken, affects many users, workaround exists
priority_guide.Medium: Partial feature broken, affects some users, workaround available
priority_guide.Low: Minor issue, cosmetic, affects few users, or enhancement
